query:
UPDATE orders SET
                broker_order_id = ?,
                filled_quantity = ?,
                status = ?,
                submitted_at = ?,
                filled_at = ?,
                filled_avg_price = ?,
                commission = ?,
                error_message = ?
            WHERE broker_order_id = ? OR id = (
                SELECT id FROM orders WHERE broker_order_id IS NULL
                ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
            )
